## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior or operational change and link the affected spec.

## Verification

Record relevant tests and any limitations. Wait for the `verify` check before merging.

## Self-review

- [ ] Diff and generated artifacts inspected; no credentials or private content included.
- [ ] Relevant tests passed; specification and source notes updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Deployment or rollback implications recorded when applicable.

A second-person approval is not required for this solo-maintained repository.
